description: Ranks the candidates of a design before anything is saved (Order & Select on acubic.ai): the ranked list, page by page, with score, per-factor values (vs industry: also the peers' median), sector, country and asset class, and the pick the site would make. A fresh ranking uses one portfolio generation. The list is kept 1 hour under candidates_id: paging, previewing a pick or re-ranking it cost nothing more, and acubic_create_strategy saves the pick, once per weighting you want to compare. It saves nothing. To count names that pass filters use acubic_screen_universe.

metric.description: A filter metric id (acubic_list_strategy_options, section filters).

value.description: The metric's unit: US dollars for market_cap, percent for pct metrics (40 = 40%).

McpCountRange.description: Number of assets, min and max.

McpGroupBound.description: Share of the selection by count, percent.

McpRanking.description: A preset: card. The engine: rank_method or rank_blend.

card.description: A preset's ranking card, from its menu in acubic_list_strategy_templates (by template_id, or experience and risk_level).

McpSelectionLimits.description: Group names as acubic_rank_candidates rows show them.

default_max_pct.description: Default max percent for every sector or country without its own cap.

max_weight_pct.description: 1 to 100, step 1; at most 60 unless the lowest asset count is 1 (then 100).

candidates_id.description: A ranked list from acubic_rank_candidates (valid 1 hour).

correlation_limit.description: Not offered yet: omit it unless acubic_list_strategy_options shows it offered; then 0.50-0.95, step 0.05 (preset: 0.80).

custom_symbols.description: Tickers to add to the pool, checked as on acubic.ai.

excluded_symbols.description: Names removed from the screened pool (Step 1).

experience.description: Legacy: beginner or intermediate with risk_level selects a preset; prefer template_id. Omit for an engine build.

filter_rules.description: Each rule: metric, op, value in the metric's own unit.

locked_symbols.description: Always selected, exempt from every filter.

position_sizing.description: Default: the sizes recommended for the number of assets.

ranking.description: A preset: card (acubic_list_strategy_templates). The engine: rank_method or rank_blend. With candidates_id: re-rank that pool.

recipe_id.description: A recipe id (acubic_list_strategy_options, recipes): sets ranking, sectors, allocation and asset count unless given; your filter_rules add to its own.

risk_level.description: Preset only (legacy path): largest acceptable drawdown; prefer template_id.

select_count.description: Top N to select (10, 15, 20, 30 or 50 within the count range; see selection.select_counts). Not with selected_symbols.

selected_symbols.description: Preview a hand-picked selection of candidates_id (not with allocation or correlation limits).

selection_limits.description: Min/max share of the selection per sector, country or asset class.

template_id.description: An id from acubic_list_strategy_templates: a preset, or advanced for the engine.

name: acubic_rank_candidates

Peer.description: Factors ranked vs industry: the median of similar companies, in value's unit; null when no group answered. Low Debt to Equity sends both negated (higher is better): show them positive.

PeerDisplay.description: The median as acubic.ai shows it, with its group (industry 20.0).

PeerLevel.description: The group the median is over, the first with enough companies: region+industry, region+sector, global industry, global sector, all stocks.

candidates_id.description: The kept ranked list; acubic_create_strategy and this tool accept it for 1 hour.

client_request_id.description: The idempotency key this call used (yours, or one made for it). Repeat the call with it to get the same run without a second charge.

pool.description: Names ranked from: the screen plus names added by hand.

screened.description: Names the screen returned before Step 1.

quota_unavailable.description: True when the quota counters could not be read after the work was saved; the work is saved.

label.description: The ranking's name as acubic.ai shows it.

display.description: The value as acubic.ai formats it.

key.description: The column: the factor id, or factor@days when a factor appears on two windows.

label.description: The column's name as acubic.ai shows it.

percentile.description: 0 to 1 within the ranked pool (1 is best); what the blend weighted.

value.description: The company's own value, in the factor's unit (acubic_explain); null when it could not be scored.

model_rank.description: Acubic Model only: its rank, no score.

rank.description: Position in the ranked list, 1 is best.

score.description: The ranking's score (a blend: weighted percentile 0 to 1; one factor: its own value, or ranked vs industry its comparison with peer); null when unscored.

score_display.description: The score as acubic.ai shows it (a blend: the blended rank).

selected.description: In the selection the builder would make.

value.description: One factor ranked vs industry: the company's own value.

blocked.description: Why this selection cannot be made; the builder would not continue.

cash_seats.description: Seats the correlation limit left empty, held as cash.

count_range.description: Assets a selection may hold (the number of assets, the position sizes and the pool).

available.description: Names of the group in the ranked list.

held.description: Both bounds hold, counted as the selection counts them. False when the list or the other limits could not meet one; reason says why.

locked.description: Names in the group the person locked.

reason.description: Only when held is false: why the bound could not be met.

share_pct.description: Names held as a share of the seats the selection was made for, percent.

select_counts.description: The Top N values select_count accepts here, besides the maximum.

title: Rank candidates
